entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7096"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 142</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.142.1-Ps.142.7">Psa 142:1-7</reference>. Maschil--(See on <reference osisRef="Ps.32.1">Psa 32:1</reference>, title). When he was in the cave--either of Adullam (<reference osisRef="1Sam.22.1">1Sa 22:1</reference>), or En-gedi (<reference osisRef="1Sam.24.3">1Sa 24:3</reference>). This does not mean that the Psalm was composed in the cave, but that the precarious mode of life, of which his refuge in caves was a striking illustration, occasioned the complaint, which constitutes the first part of the Psalm and furnishes the reason for the prayer with which it concludes, and which, as the prominent characteristic, gives its name.</title> <div sID="gen10880" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7096"/><hi type="bold">1. with my voice--</hi>audibly, because earnestly. <div eID="gen10880" type="x-p"/>
